items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: But his brother Ramos, that's all he'd play. He never played in the dance band. Ramos. Ramos played in the street.

ctx.x: Bebe, best mostly in the dance band or on the street? What was he famous for?

The boys he played in the dance band. Dance band. I never remember him playing. But his brother Ramos, that's all he'd play. He never played in the dance band. Ramos. Ramos played in the street. Played in the street all the time. That's all he had. A snare, you know. I never remember. There ain't no one could play. You know, drop drums.
You ever hear of John McMurray or Diddy Chandler.
